full_text_en:
Suzhou Huqiu District People's Procuratorate of Jiangsu Province v. Chengdu Gongruan Network Technology Co., Ltd., Sun Xianzhong, Zhang Tianping, Hong Lei, and Liang Zhuoyong — dispute over copyright infringement

[Ruling Summary]

I. Pursuant to Article 217 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China, where a person, for the purpose of profit, reproduces and distributes the copyright owner's written works, musical works, films, television works, video works, computer software, or other works without the permission of the copyright owner, and the amount of illegal gains is relatively large or there are other serious circumstances, the person shall constitute the crime of copyright infringement. In determining whether the person's conduct constitutes the crime of copyright infringement, analysis shall be conducted from the following aspects: whether the person is for the purpose of profit, whether the reproduction is without the permission of the copyright owner, and whether the act of distribution has been carried out.

II. Where a person reproduces computer software without the permission of the copyright owner, bundles other software after modifying the corresponding programs, publishes it on the Internet for others to download, and thereby obtains revenue such as advertising fees, such conduct constitutes the act of "reproduction and distribution" "for the purpose of profit" as provided in Article 217 of the Criminal Law.

Prosecuting Authority: Suzhou Huqiu District People's Procuratorate of Jiangsu Province.

Defendant Entity: Chengdu Gongruan Network Technology Co., Ltd., domiciled at No. 9, Kehua Zhong Road, Wuhou District, Chengdu, Sichuan Province.

Legal Representative: Sun Zhiqiang, Legal Representative of the said company.

Defendant: Sun Xianzhong, male, 29 years old, General Manager of Chengdu Gongruan Network Technology Co., Ltd., domiciled at Daguanyan Street, Jinjiang District, Chengdu, Sichuan Province. Arrested in connection with this case on January 22, 2009.

Defendant: Zhang Tianping, male, 27 years old, Marketing Director of Chengdu Gongruan Network Technology Co., Ltd. and Manager of Chengdu Hongguo Technology Co., Ltd., domiciled at Longqiao Village, Tashui Town, An County, Sichuan Province. Arrested in connection with this case on September 19, 2008.

Defendant: Hong Lei, male, 30 years old, Head of "Tomato Garden Studio", domiciled at Yushan Road, Suzhou, Jiangsu Province. Arrested in connection with this case on September 19, 2008.

Defendant: Liang Zhuoyong, also known as Liang Guohua, male, 29 years old, Employee of "Tomato Garden Studio", domiciled at Huancheng West Road, Panyu District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province. Arrested in connection with this case on September 19, 2008.

The Suzhou Huqiu District People's Procuratorate of Jiangsu Province initiated a public prosecution against the defendant entity Chengdu Gongruan Network Technology Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Gongruan Company) and the defendants Sun Xianzhong, Zhang Tianping, Hong Lei, and Liang Zhuoyong for the crime of copyright infringement, and filed the case with the Suzhou Huqiu District People's Court of Jiangsu Province.

Allegations in the Indictment: During the period from December 2006 to August 2008, Sichuan Wanglian Hudong Advertising Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Wanglian Advertising Company, separately handled) and the defendant entity Gongruan Company, for profit-making purposes, acted under the direction of defendant Sun Xianzhong, and through the cooperation of defendant Zhang Tianping with defendants Hong Lei and Liang Zhuoyong, reproduced Microsoft Windows XP computer software without the permission of Microsoft Corporation, creating multiple versions of the "Tomato Garden" edition software. By modifying browser homepages, default search pages, and bundling software of other companies, they loaded commercial plug-ins of Baidu Online Network Technology (Beijing) Co., Ltd., Beijing Alibaba Information Technology Co., Ltd., Beijing Sogou Technology Development Co., Ltd., Flashget Information Technology Co., Ltd., and other entities into the "Tomato Garden" edition software. The software was published on the "Tomato Garden" website and the "Redu" website via the Internet for public download over 100,000 times. Baidu Online Network Technology (Beijing) Co., Ltd., Beijing Alibaba Information Technology Co., Ltd., Beijing Sogou Technology Development Co., Ltd., and Flashget Information Technology Co., Ltd. paid a total of RMB 2,977,630.39 in advertising fees to Wanglian Advertising Company and Gongruan Company. Article 217 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China (hereinafter referred to as the Criminal Law) provides: "Whoever, for the purpose of profit, commits any of the following acts of copyright infringement, if the amount of illegal gains is relatively large or there are other serious circumstances, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention, and shall also, or shall only, be fined; if the amount of illegal gains is huge or there are other especially serious circumstances, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years, and shall also be fined: (1) reproducing and distributing the copyright owner's written works, musical works, films, television works, video works, computer software, or other works without the permission of the copyright owner; ..." According to this provision, the conduct of Gongruan Company, Sun Xianzhong, Zhang Tianping, Hong Lei, and Liang Zhuoyong all constitute the crime of copyright infringement and shall be punished according to law. Zhang Tianping surrendered himself, and thus may be given a lighter or mitigated punishment according to law. The court is requested to hear the case according to law.

Defense of the Defendant Entity Gongruan Company: The defendant entity did not violate the law, nor did the legal representative of the defendant entity know that the entity's conduct violated the law.

Argument of Defense Counsel for the Defendant Entity Gongruan Company: Neither the defendant entity nor its legal representative, board of shareholders, or board of directors participated in the "Tomato Garden" infringement in any form. Objectively, the defendant entity did not sign a cooperation contract with defendant Hong Lei. The personal conduct of defendant Sun Xianzhong cannot represent the conduct of the entity. The income involved of the defendant entity began from April 2007 and should be distinguished from the income of Wanglian Advertising Company. The over 2.9 million yuan alleged in the indictment includes the legal income of the defendant entity, which should be deducted. The defendant entity possesses a large amount of independent intellectual property rights and has made significant contributions to the state and society. It is currently on the verge of bankruptcy due to the freezing of its accounts. The court is requested to consider the actual circumstances of the defendant entity and protect its lawful rights and interests according to law.

Defense of Defendant Sun Xianzhong: The criminal facts alleged in the indictment are incorrect. Before the case came to light, I gave defendant Zhang Tianping a free hand to cooperate with "Tomato Garden". It was only after the case was exposed that I learned that "Tomato Garden" had infringed upon Microsoft's software copyright. My conduct does not constitute a crime.

Argument of Defense Counsel for Defendant Sun Xianzhong: Sun Xianzhong did not carry out the illegal reproduction or distribution of others' computer software. His business activities were network promotion alliances, i.e., using his own software, theme resource packs, Gediao.com, and Speed Browser to cooperate with other companies. Sun Xianzhong did not have the subjective intent to illegally reproduce or distribute Microsoft Windows XP software, nor did he instruct defendant Hong Lei to infringe others' copyright. The over 2.9 million yuan alleged in the indictment includes income from legal operations. The distribution of Microsoft Windows XP software also involved secondary dissemination by others through burning discs. Sun Xianzhong's subjective malignancy is very low, his attitude toward admitting guilt is good, and he did not obtain personal benefits from the relevant activities. The court is requested to handle the case according to the principle of "when in doubt, acquit" in accordance with law.

Defense of Defendant Zhang Tianping: Defendant Zhang Tianping has no objection to the criminal facts alleged in the indictment.

Argument of Defense Counsel for Defendant Zhang Tianping: During the course of his work, Zhang Tianping gradually learned that there was Microsoft Windows XP software available for download on the "Tomato Garden" website. However, Zhang Tianping did not participate in the reproduction or distribution. His conduct was merely to fulfill his job responsibilities, and his subjective malignancy was very low. As the Marketing Director of the defendant entity Gongruan Company, Zhang Tianping placed advertisements on the "Tomato Garden" website as required by the company, based on his job duties, and did not personally participate in the reproduction or distribution of Microsoft Windows XP software. Zhang Tianping surrendered himself, has a good attitude toward admitting guilt, and is a first-time offender. The court is requested to impose a mitigated punishment on Zhang Tianping according to law.

Defense of Defendant Hong Lei: Defendant Hong Lei has no objection to the criminal facts alleged in the indictment.

Argument of Defense Counsel for Defendant Hong Lei: The indictment's determination that the amount of illegal gains was huge and the circumstances were serious lacks factual basis. The existing evidence cannot confirm that the advertising fees of over 2 million yuan paid by Baidu and other entities to Wanglian Advertising Company and the defendant entity Gongruan Company corresponded entirely to the income from the reproduction and distribution of the "Tomato Garden" edition of Microsoft Windows XP software. The indictment's allegation that the defendant entity and defendants published Microsoft Windows XP software on the "Tomato Garden" website and the "Redu" website via the Internet for public download, totaling over 100,000 times, lacks basis and can only be considered as general click counts.

Defense of Defendant Liang Zhuoyong: Defendant Liang Zhuoyong has no objection to the criminal facts alleged in the indictment.

Argument of Defense Counsel for Defendant Liang Zhuoyong: Liang Zhuoyong was merely an employee of "Tomato Garden Studio". He created the beautified version of Microsoft Windows XP software at the request of defendant Hong Lei, which constituted only a small part of the entire case. Initially, Liang Zhuoyong's personal income was 3% of Hong Lei's income, later changed to RMB 8,000 per month, indicating that Liang Zhuoyong did not play a major role in this case; he was an accessory and should receive a lighter or mitigated punishment. The advertising fee income alleged in the indictment is not equivalent to illegal gains, and includes some legal income.

Facts Found by the Suzhou Huqiu District People's Court:

During the period from December 2006 to August 2008, Wanglian Advertising Company and the defendant entity Gongruan Company, for profit-making purposes, acted under the direction of defendant Sun Xianzhong, through the cooperation of defendant Zhang Tianping with defendants Hong Lei and Liang Zhuoyong, reproduced Microsoft Windows XP computer software without the permission of Microsoft Corporation, creating multiple versions of "Tomato Garden" edition software. By modifying browser homepages, default search pages, and bundling software of other companies, they loaded commercial plug-ins of Baidu Online Network Technology (Beijing) Co., Ltd., Beijing Alibaba Information Technology Co., Ltd., Beijing Sogou Technology Development Co., Ltd., Flashget Information Technology Co., Ltd., and other entities into the "Tomato Garden" edition software. The software was published on the "Tomato Garden" website and the "Redu" website via the Internet for public download. Among them, the "Tomato Garden" WINXP SP3 V.3300, WINXP SP2 V3.3, WINXP SP3 V1.0, WINXP SP2 V3.5, WINXP SP2 V3.4, WINXP SP3 V1.21, WINXP SP3 V1.1, WINXP SP2 Installation Edition, and Activation-Free Edition, produced under the responsibility of Hong Lei, were downloaded a total of 71,583 times. The "Tomato Garden" WINXP SP2 V6.2 and LEINLITE XP SP3 V1.0 beautified versions, produced under the responsibility of Liang Zhuoyong, were downloaded a total of 8,018 times. The "Tomato Garden" GHOST XP SP3 V1.0, GHOST XP SP3 V1.1, and GHOST XP SP3 V1.2 versions, produced under the responsibility of Zheng Guobin (separately handled), were downloaded a total of 117,308 times. Gongruan Company obtained illegal proceeds of RMB 935,665.53 from Baidu Online Network Technology (Beijing) Co., Ltd., RMB 1,611,996.46 from Beijing Alibaba Information Technology Co., Ltd., RMB 69,538.50 from Beijing Sogou Technology Development Co., Ltd., and RMB 307,086.60 from Flashget Information Technology Co., Ltd. In total, the illegal gains involved of Gongruan Company amounted to RMB 2,924,287.09.

The above facts are confirmed by the following evidence submitted by the prosecuting authority: the Microsoft Windows XP Professional software registration certificate and supporting documents, the software product registration certificates for Microsoft Windows Server V2003 and Windows XP Professional Edition, the appraisal reports No. Zhongban Jian Zi (2008) No. 008 to No. 024 and the supplementary explanations for appraisal reports No. Zhongban Jian Zi (2008) No. 008 to No. 024-2 issued by the Copyright Appraisal Committee of the China Copyright Protection Center, the cooperation agreements and contracts of Gongruan Company, bank transaction details, accounting detail lists, household historical transaction details lists, fund flow details, DWSO general ledger, DWSO classification details, testimonies of witnesses including Zheng Guobin, Chen Changmei, Hou Yan, Xia Qianzi, He Hongmei, Xue Bai, Liu Zhiyu, Wang Xiaoyang, Wei Xiao, Tong Weiliang, etc., the remote inspection work records and electronic evidence inspection records made by the Information Network Security Supervision Division of the Suzhou Municipal Public Security Bureau, and the case discovery and solution report and search records issued by the Huqiu Branch of the Suzhou Municipal Public Security Bureau. The evidence is sufficient to confirm.

Issues in Controversy in this Case: Whether the conduct of the defendant entity Gongruan Company and the defendants Sun Xianzhong, Zhang Tianping, Hong Lei, and Liang Zhuoyong constitutes the crime of copyright infringement.

Opinion of the Suzhou Huqiu District People's Court:

Article 217 of the Criminal Law provides: "Whoever, for the purpose of profit, commits any of the following acts of copyright infringement, if the amount of illegal gains is relatively large or there are other serious circumstances, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention, and shall also, or shall only, be fined; if the amount of illegal gains is huge or there are other especially serious circumstances, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years, and shall also be fined: (1) reproducing and distributing the copyright owner's written works, musical works, films, television works, video works, computer software, or other works without the permission of the copyright owner; ..." This Article clearly stipulates the crime of copyright infringement. To determine whether the conduct of the defendant entity Gongruan Company and the defendants Sun Xianzhong, Zhang Tianping, Hong Lei, and Liang Zhuoyong constitutes the crime of copyright infringement, analysis shall be conducted according to this Article from the following aspects: whether the person is for the purpose of profit, whether the reproduction is without the permission of the software copyright owner, and whether the act of distribution has been carried out.

First, the issue of whether the defendant entity Gongruan Company and the defendants Sun Xianzhong, Zhang Tianping, Hong Lei, and Liang Zhuoyong carried out the involved conduct for the purpose of profit. Article 11(1) of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Several Issues Concerning the Specific Application of Law in the Handling of Criminal Cases of Infringement of Intellectual Property Rights provides: "Circumstances such as directly or indirectly collecting fees by publishing paid advertisements fall within the scope of 'for the purpose of profit' as provided in Article 217 of the Criminal Law." In this case, although the defendant entity and the defendants published the involved "Tomato Garden" edition of Windows series software on the "Tomato Garden" website and the "Redu" website via the Internet for free public download and did not directly profit therefrom, at the same time as publishing the involved "Tomato Garden" edition of Windows series software, the defendant entity and the defendants obtained substantial indirect income, including advertising fees and promotion fees, totaling RMB 2,924,287.09, by modifying browser homepages, default search pages, and bundling client commercial software that needed to be promoted. Therefore, it can be determined that the true intent of Gongruan Company, Sun Xianzhong, Zhang Tianping, Hong Lei, and Liang Zhuoyong in carrying out the involved conduct was precisely to pursue substantial advertising fee and promotion fee income, clearly showing a profit-making purpose.

Second, the issue of whether the defendant entity Gongruan Company and the defendants Sun Xianzhong, Zhang Tianping, Hong Lei, and Liang Zhuoyong reproduced the involved series of software without the permission of the copyright owner. Upon investigation, Microsoft Corporation is the lawful copyright owner of Microsoft Windows software. According to the remote inspection work record made by the Information Network Security Supervision Division of the Suzhou Municipal Public Security Bureau, the "Tomato Garden" edition of Windows series software indicated on its interface that the software was produced by "Tomato Garden" under the authorization of Microsoft Corporation. However, according to the certification issued by Microsoft Corporation, Microsoft Corporation did not authorize any individual or company to produce its software. According to the appraisal reports No. Zhongban Jian Zi (2008) No. 008 to No. 024 and the supplementary explanations for appraisal reports No. Zhongban Jian Zi (2008) No. 008 to No. 024-2 issued by the Copyright Appraisal Committee of the China Copyright Protection Center, upon comparison between the involved "Tomato Garden" edition of Windows series software and Microsoft Windows software, the core programs of both are concentrated in the Windows directory, and the directory structures and files of the two have a large amount of identical content. Accordingly, it can be determined that the involved "Tomato Garden" edition of Windows series software was the product of reproduction based on the core programs of Microsoft Windows software, and the defendant entity and the defendants carried out the infringing reproduction without the permission of the software copyright owner. In their statements, the defendants Sun Xianzhong, Zhang Tianping, Hong Lei, and Liang Zhuoyong also admitted that the involved "Tomato Garden" edition of Windows series software was created by pirating Microsoft Windows software and then modifying and beautifying it.

Third, the issue of whether the defendant entity Gongruan Company and the defendants Sun Xianzhong, Zhang Tianping, Hong Lei, and Liang Zhuoyong carried out the act of distribution. "Distribution" in the field of information networks has certain particularities and differs from "distribution" through general media. According to Article 11(3) of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Several Issues Concerning the Specific Application of Law in the Handling of Criminal Cases of Infringement of Intellectual Property Rights, the act of transmitting others' written works, musical works, films, television works, video works, computer software, or other works to the public through information networks shall be deemed as the act of "distribution" as provided in Article 217 of the Criminal Law. Accordingly, in this case, the defendant entity and the defendants published the involved "Tomato Garden" edition of Windows series software via the Internet for download by unspecified members of the public. Regardless of whether they charged download fees, this conduct shall be deemed as the act of "distribution" as provided in Article 217 of the Criminal Law.

Article 5, paragraph 2 of the *Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Several Issues Concerning the Specific Application of Law in Handling Criminal Cases of Infringement of Intellectual Property Rights* provides: "Where, for the purpose of profit, a person commits any of the acts of copyright infringement listed in Article 217 of the Criminal Law, and the amount of illegal gains is RMB 150,000 or more, the amount of illegal gains shall be deemed 'huge'..." According to the facts found in this case, the defendant unit Gongruan Company and the defendants Sun Xianzhong, Zhang Tianping, Hong Lei, and Liang Zhuoyong earned a total of RMB 2,924,287.09 in advertising fees and promotion fees through the conduct involved in the case, which constitutes a huge amount of illegal gains. Article 1 of the *Interpretation (II) of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Several Issues Concerning the Specific Application of Law in Handling Criminal Cases of Infringement of Intellectual Property Rights* provides: "Where, for the purpose of profit, without permission of the copyright owner, a person reproduces and distributes the copyright owner's written works, musical works, cinematographic works, television works, video recordings, computer software, or other works, and the total number of copies is 500 (copies) or more, this falls under the 'other serious circumstances' provided in Article 217 of the Criminal Law; where the total number of copies is 2,500 (copies) or more, this falls under the 'other particularly serious circumstances' provided in Article 217 of the Criminal Law." According to the results of the remote inspection conducted by the Information Network Security Supervision Division of the Suzhou Municipal Public Security Bureau on the "Tomato Garden" website and the "Redu" website, the infringing software produced by Hong Lei, including "Tomato Garden" WINXPSP3V.3300, WINXPSP2V3.3, WINXPSP3V1.0, WINXPSP2V3.5, WINXPSP2V3.4, WINXPSP3V1.21, WINXPSP3V1.1, and WINXPSP2 installation version and activation-free version, was downloaded 71,583 times in total; the infringing software produced by Liang Zhuoyong, including "Tomato Garden" WINXPSP2V6.2 and LEINLITEXPSP3V1.0 beautified version, was downloaded 8,018 times in total. Accordingly, it can be determined that the total number of copies involved in the case exceeded 2,500 copies, and the defendant unit and the defendants, in committing the copyright infringement conduct involved in the case, had "other particularly serious circumstances" as provided in Article 217 of the Criminal Law.

In summary, the defendant unit Gongruan Company and the defendants Sun Xianzhong, Zhang Tianping, Hong Lei, and Liang Zhuoyong, for the purpose of profit, reproduced and distributed computer software without the permission of the copyright owner. The amount of illegal gains was huge, and the circumstances were particularly serious. They have all constituted the crime of copyright infringement. Sun Xianzhong, as the person directly in charge of the defendant unit, and Zhang Tianping, as the person directly responsible for the defendant unit, shall bear criminal liability in accordance with law. In the joint crime, the defendant unit, Sun Xianzhong, Zhang Tianping, and Hong Lei all played a principal role and are all principals; they shall be punished for all crimes in which they participated. Liang Zhuoyong, acting under the direction of Hong Lei, reproduced and distributed computer software of others, playing an accessory role in the joint crime; he is an accessory and shall be given a mitigated punishment. Zhang Tianping voluntarily surrendered after committing the crime and truthfully confessed his own crime, constituting voluntary surrender; a mitigated punishment may be given in accordance with law. Accordingly, the Huqiu District People's Court of Suzhou, Jiangsu Province, in accordance with Article 217, paragraph 1, subparagraph (1); Article 220; Article 25, paragraphs 1 and 4; Article 64; Article 27, paragraphs 1 and 2; Article 67, paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law; and Article 5, paragraph 2 of the *Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Several Issues Concerning the Specific Application of Law in Handling Criminal Cases of Infringement of Intellectual Property Rights*; and Article 1 of the *Interpretation (II) of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Several Issues Concerning the Specific Application of Law in Handling Criminal Cases of Infringement of Intellectual Property Rights*, rendered the following judgment on August 20, 2009:

1. The defendant unit Chengdu Gongruan Network Technology Co., Ltd. is convicted of the crime of copyright infringement and sentenced to a fine of RMB 8,772,861.27, to be turned over to the State Treasury.

2. The defendant Sun Xianzhong is convicted of the crime of copyright infringement and sentenced to three years and six months of fixed-term imprisonment, and a fine of RMB 1,000,000, to be turned over to the State Treasury.

3. The defendant Zhang Tianping is convicted of the crime of copyright infringement and sentenced to two years of fixed-term imprisonment, and a fine of RMB 100,000, to be turned over to the State Treasury.

4. The defendant Hong Lei is convicted of the crime of copyright infringement and sentenced to three years and six months of fixed-term imprisonment, and a fine of RMB 1,000,000, to be turned over to the State Treasury.

5. The defendant Liang Zhuoyong is convicted of the crime of copyright infringement and sentenced to two years of fixed-term imprisonment, and a fine of RMB 100,000, to be turned over to the State Treasury.

6. The illegal gains of the defendant unit Chengdu Gongruan Network Technology Co., Ltd. in the amount of RMB 2,924,287.09 shall be confiscated and turned over to the State Treasury.

After the first-instance judgment was pronounced, none of the defendant unit Gongruan Company and the defendants Sun Xianzhong, Zhang Tianping, Hong Lei, and Liang Zhuoyong filed an appeal, and the prosecutorial authority did not file a protest. The first-instance judgment has become legally effective.
